s: a low-key railway-arch food market that stayed a local secret
w: Under the railway arches of a former ropewalk, this Bermondsey market skips Borough's crowds for a smaller, more artisanal crowd -- coffee roasters, natural wine bars, cheesemongers, and stalls turning out sourdough pizza and smoked fish. Many of the traders also supply top restaurants. A slow Saturday-morning wander rather than a tourist stampede.
_facts: Runs under railway arches on Maltby Street and Ropewalk, Bermondsey SE1
Trades primarily on Saturdays (some stalls open Sunday)
Grew out of the wholesale trade around Spa Terminus / Ropewalk
Known for producer-run stalls that also supply restaurants
